The lighting creates soft shadows on the white background.

The red translucent object has inconsistent thickness and warped edges. Its interaction with the white surface and the lighter lacks precise physical contact definition, appearing slightly floated or fused.
The transition between the plastic nozzle and the base of the flame is slightly soft and lacks the sharp thermal distortion or crisp edge expected in a macro shot of a real flame.
